name: MobileGlues: CPU and GPU at once on older Malis
about: Each frame is shown one later, so the processor works on the next frame while the GPU draws this one. On the Mali-G52: 30 FPS standing and 20 moving without it; with it 45 and 30 at first, 60 and 45 once the game had settled. On a GPU that is already the limit it shows fewer frames, so it is only on here.
